priorities.summary: An integer overflow in the Onigmo regex engine used to compile regular expressions in GitLab CI/CD configuration files allows unauthenticated remote code execution on self-managed GitLab instances that allow self-registration and public projects. Fixed in GitLab 19.2.8, 19.3.5 and 19.4.2; CISA added it to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on October 29, with a November 1 remediation date for federal agencies.

The Gravity Forms plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP object injection in all versions up to and including 3.1.2, via a Post Custom Field whose input type is List. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit the deserialization flaw; update Gravity Forms to a fixed release.

Improperly controlled modification of dynamically-determined object attributes in the Drupal Block AJAX module allows PHP object injection, affecting Block AJAX versions from 0.0.0 to 3.0.2. Update Block AJAX to a version beyond 3.0.2.

model.name: Gemini 4 Carbon
model.summary: Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon on October 28 as its strongest model, with state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long-horizon capabilities, ranking first on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 at 59. Rollout starts with a subset of cyber defenders through the Fairwind Program, with no date yet for developers, businesses or consumers.
